name: autovacuum_vacuum_insert_threshold
description: Minimum number of newly inserted tuples that triggers an autovacuum VACUUM operation on a table; -1 disables insert-triggered vacuums.
symptoms: Query performance degradation due to outdated statistics
Increased disk usage from dead tuple buildup
Longer vacuum runtime due to deferred cleanup
tuning_tips: Lower this value (e.g., 100–500) for tables with frequent inserts and rapid bloat; raise it or set to -1 for append-only or bulk-loaded tables where insert-triggered vacuums are unnecessary. Prefer per-table settings for heterogeneous workloads.
